_comment: The Codex delta (issue #611). hooks/settings-hooks.json is the ONE source of
the fleet's hook table; this file declares the only ways the Codex target
differs from it, so the Codex wiring stops being a hand-transcoded second
copy inside bin/fleet-codex.sh. bin/fleet-hooks-emit.sh applies this map and
emits the `-c hooks.<Event>=[…]` TOML the launcher passes to codex.
Verified against codex-cli 0.154: Codex's hook system IS Claude Code's schema
— same event names, same stdin JSON, exit 2 blocks, $TMUX_PANE inherited.

events.SessionStart: Claude-only: handoff-latch-reset-hook.sh resets a latch the Codex path never sets (no /fleet-handoff, no @ctx_pct).
events.SessionEnd: Codex reports reason=other for EVERY end, so the prompt_input_exit|logout matcher that tells a manual /exit from a /clear cannot fire. The cleanup daemon + ledger-watch reap a Codex window instead.

matcher_notes.Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit: Codex edits through ONE tool: apply_patch, with the patch text in tool_input.command.
matcher_notes.Artifact: Codex has no Artifact tool, so artifact-guard.py has nothing to guard.

drop_commands.classify-hook.sh: Reads a Claude Code transcript (~/.claude/projects/**.jsonl) to correct the ambiguous `done`; Codex keeps its own rollout files.
